lines.zh: 沙子灌进我的关节，又磨出去。
lines.en: Sand fills my joints and grinds out again.

lines.zh: 我走一步，沙丘就换一条脊。
lines.en: Each step redraws a dune ridge.
The noon sand burns; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我沿着旧路巡，脚印早被埋了。
lines.en: I walk my old route; prints long buried.
My feet are broad; I never sink.
Wind pushes sand; sand pushes me.

lines.zh: 我绕过仙人掌，不是怕刺。
lines.en: I go around the cactus, not out of fear.
Sand in my frame is always hissing.
Past the horizon, more sand.
I walk slowly, but I do not stop.
I stand on the crest and watch all sides.
A sentinel does not sleep.

lines.zh: 我的胸口嵌着一块水晶。
lines.en: A crystal is set in my chest.

lines.zh: 沙暴来的时候，我最高兴。
lines.en: Sandstorms are when I am happiest.
This stone plate has baked a thousand years.

lines.zh: 我数沙丘，数到第四座就忘了。
lines.en: I count dunes, and forget at the fourth.
Wind has rounded my edges.
I know what lies buried here.

lines.zh: 有人从这儿走过，三年前。
lines.en: Someone crossed here three years ago.
Sand settles on my shoulder; I leave it.
I listen to water moving underground.
The sun leans; shadows lengthen.

lines.zh: 从刷怪蛋里出来时，我带着一身沙。
lines.en: I came from the egg covered in sand.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠需要有人看着。
lines.en: This desert needs a watcher.
Sand runs through my fingers.
I count the wind: one, two, three.
You are standing on my patrol line.
Keep the waterskin still; I hear it.

lines.zh: 你脸上的沙子，是自己弄的。
lines.en: That sand on your face is your doing.
I have not seen a living person in ages.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太薄，走不出这片沙。
lines.en: Those boots are too thin for this sand.

lines.zh: 抬头，我的影子够你乘凉。
lines.en: Look up; my shadow is shade enough.

lines.zh: 你背后是沙，前面也是沙。
lines.en: Sand behind you, sand ahead.
I know that iron at your belt.
Do not reach for my crystal.
You should not have come at noon.

lines.zh: 我看了你一路，从沙梁那边。
lines.en: I watched you all the way from the ridge.
I have memorized your footprints.
Stone feels pain; it just does not say.
You cut off a piece of sandstone.
Sand will fill the crack itself.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我记起自己的年纪。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of my age.

lines.zh: 我的甲很厚，你的剑很薄。
lines.en: My plate is thick; your blade is thin.
You hit beside the crystal.

lines.zh: 沙从伤口流出来，不是血。
lines.en: Sand flows from the wound, not blood.
I step back; the dune catches me.
It hurts, but a sentinel does not leave post.

lines.zh: 这一剑，刻进我的甲里了。
lines.en: That blade carved into my plate.
Water to lure me? I am not thirsty.

lines.zh: 那点食物，风一吹全是沙。
lines.en: That food will be all sand in one gust.
I do not eat; I guard.

lines.zh: 你把东西埋在沙里，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Bury it in the sand and I will overlook it.

lines.zh: 我想要的，是那枚水晶回来。
lines.en: What I want is my crystal back.

lines.zh: 你手里的水，留着自己喝。
lines.en: Keep that water for yourself.

lines.zh: 诱惑对我没用，我是石头做的。
lines.en: Temptation fails; I am made of stone.
Raise it higher; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 这片沙下，没有东西能换命。
lines.en: Nothing under this sand buys a life.

lines.zh: 你越哄，我越觉得你可疑。
lines.en: The more you coax, the more suspect you seem.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是石柱，不是人。
lines.en: You hit a pillar, not a person.

lines.zh: 我身上的沙，落了你一头。
lines.en: My sand fell all over your head.

lines.zh: 我们错身时，你的肩响了。
lines.en: As we passed, your shoulder cracked.

lines.zh: 我退半步，沙就埋了你的脚。
lines.en: I step back; sand buries your feet.
Do not push; I outweigh this dune.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你尝到沙的味道了。
lines.en: Now you taste sand.
My stone plate has no soft spot.
Walk that close and you will dry out.
Sand flows between us.
Step aside; I continue my round.
Stone does not seek a mate.

lines.zh: 我在这里守了太久，忘了怎么。
lines.en: I have guarded too long to remember how.

lines.zh: 沙暴里没有第二个哨兵。
lines.en: No second sentinel walks the sandstorm.
My consort is this desert.
The sand does that for me.
I have patrol, and nothing else.
You ask too near.
Perhaps a thousand years ago, there was.
I am not lonely; I have the wind.
Say no more; the sand listens.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块砂岩，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up sandstone and weigh it.

lines.zh: 这枚碎片，和我的甲同色。
lines.en: This shard matches my plate.
I tuck it into the crack in my chest.
Too light; the wind will take it.

lines.zh: 我捡了，就埋在沙丘背面。
lines.en: I take it and bury it behind the dune.
What you drop, I keep safe.
Everything in the sand is mine.
This thing is rough in the hand.
I hold it up against the sun.

lines.zh: 它不属于这里，我带它走。
lines.en: It does not belong here; I take it away.
You stepped inside my boundary.
My crystal is heating up.

lines.zh: 风停了，这是动手前的安静。
lines.en: The wind stopped; that is the quiet before.
One target, and it is you.
I can smell the water on you.
The dune ridge points at you.

lines.zh: 我等你走到没遮没挡的地方。
lines.en: I wait till you reach open ground.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听见了。
lines.en: Your steps broke rhythm; I heard.
This sand will take one person.
I raise my hand; sand rises with it.

lines.zh: 你带了武器，那就好办了。
lines.en: You brought a weapon; simpler.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你影子最短的位置。
lines.en: I have your shortest-shadow spot.
Do not run; sand is faster.
The sentinel begins its duty.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留了印，我看得清。
lines.en: Your tracks in the sand are clear to me.

lines.zh: 这块地界，从今天起醒了。
lines.en: This stretch of sand wakes today.

lines.zh: 我把手插进沙里，摸到你。
lines.en: I push my hand into sand and feel you.
The sand has my ears in it.
I do not chase; the sand will stop you.

lines.zh: 你跑上沙丘，就慢了一半。
lines.en: Run up a dune and you lose half your speed.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the sand.
Waiting for night? Night is worse.
I push sand to your feet.

lines.zh: 你转身，我就换到另一边。
lines.en: You turn; I move to the other side.
The crystal rings like cracking glass.
I count the steps you have left.
Wind rises, sand moves, you do not.
I stand still, and you panic.

lines.zh: 你把背靠在石头上，很好。
lines.en: You put your back to stone. Good.
The sandstorm has become a wall over there.
I need not look; I listen to sand.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的范围就到了。
lines.en: A little closer, and you enter my reach.

lines.zh: 你往东，东边的沙丘会先塌。
lines.en: Go east and the dune falls first.

lines.zh: 我不抬眼，也知道你在动。
lines.en: I need not look up to know you move.
After this step, you only retreat.
The crystal's heat is at your back.
Sand has gotten into your eyes, no?

lines.zh: 我等你自己走到我手边。
lines.en: I wait for you to walk into my reach.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下，沙浪压过去。
lines.en: I bring my palm down; a wave of sand follows.
Sand pours into your collar.
This fist carries a sandstorm.
The sand scours a layer off you.
My fist lands; the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 水晶的光一闪，沙就刺过来。
lines.en: The crystal flashes, and sand spikes out.
Your breath is full of sand.
I press you into the dune.
My stone arm sweeps; your shield slips.
No blood; only sand falls.
Sand grains hit armor like rain.

lines.zh: 我抬起膝盖，地裂了一道。
lines.en: I raise a knee; the ground splits.
The ground under you gave way.
Afterwards, the sand will tidy you away.

lines.zh: 沙丘裂开，我从里面站起。
lines.en: The dune splits; I rise from it.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落进沙里，沙就开始动。
lines.en: The egg fell in sand, and the sand stirred.
I woke covered in ancient sand.

lines.zh: 太阳正毒，我选这时候出来。
lines.en: The sun was fierce; I chose that hour.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，全是尘土。
lines.en: My first breath was all dust.

lines.zh: 水晶在我胸口亮了一下。
lines.en: The crystal lit once in my chest.
The desert recognized me.

lines.zh: 我从埋了千年的位置爬起来。
lines.en: I climbed out of a thousand-year grave.
Wind smoothed my birthplace flat.

lines.zh: 远处有人在走，我看见了。
lines.en: Someone walked far off; I saw them.

lines.zh: 我成形时，沙丘矮了一截。
lines.en: When I formed, the dune shrank.
This sand again; I know it.
I straighten; my frame cracks.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里有人守了。
lines.en: From today, this place has a guard.
The sand moves first, then I do.

lines.zh: 这一片沙丘，该有人站了。
lines.en: These dunes have needed a watcher.
I rose up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 天亮之前，我已经在这里。
lines.en: I was here before dawn broke.
Sand and wind again. Good.
I pack the sand under my feet.

lines.zh: 太阳晒了千年，火算什么。
lines.en: A thousand years of sun; what is fire?
Fall from height and sand catches me.
The sand drinks the water first.
Blast-blown sand coats my face.
An arrow sticks in my plate like a straw.
That spell cannot hold the sand down.
I live on sand; I eat nothing.
Lightning struck sand and made glass.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我无处站。
lines.en: No sand in the void; nowhere to stand.
